text: Verified and archived the continued older MRI trajectory batch at evidence/halfflow-cell-admission-20261015/offline-progress-v1: 54 scored states + 101 explicitly uncaptured events = 155/162 declared events; seven captured states remain unscored. All current per-structure reports and plots retained. Both OASIS13 fine trajectories now include their 20-step endpoints: selected Dice .423217 -> .420787; step-scaled .423353 -> .421371, with lower fixed-region intensity loss in both. These use the original frozen executable and do not establish the new cell correction's MRI effect. Remaining OASIS1/OASIS17 58-state export/scoring plan is prepared and unlaunched. D01 remains open; no timing/convergence/qualification promotion.
